definitions.explanation: A tall evergreen tree native to Japan, widely used in construction and forestry. Also a common source of pollen allergies in Japan.

examples.japanese: {杉|すぎ}の{木|き}は{日本|にほん}に{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Japanese cedars are common in Japan.

examples.japanese: {春|はる}は{杉|すぎ}{花粉|かふん}がひどい。
examples.english: Cedar pollen is terrible in spring.

examples.japanese: この{家|いえ}は{杉|すぎ}の{木|き}で{建|た}てられている。
examples.english: This house is built with cedar wood.

notes:
{杉|すぎ} (Japanese cedar or cryptomeria) is one of the most common trees in Japan and is extensively used in construction due to its straight grain and durability.

CULTURAL NOTES:
{杉|すぎ}{花粉症|かふんしょう} (cedar pollen allergy) affects millions of Japanese people every spring. The extensive planting of {杉|すぎ} after WWII for forestry has made this a significant public health issue.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {杉|すぎ}の{木|き} (cedar tree)
- {杉林|すぎばやし} (cedar forest)
- {杉|すぎ}{花粉|かふん} (cedar pollen)
- {杉|すぎ}{材|ざい} (cedar wood/lumber)
- {秋田杉|あきたすぎ} (Akita cedar, famous variety)
